scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic; the supplementary finite numerical checker is not a universal proof. The known general implicit Jacobian is acknowledged, and scientific priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Exact sharp result for the maximum-entry norm of the fixed-marginal 2 by 2 entropy-coupling map. Does not cover changing marginals, higher-dimensional coupling tables, or finite Sinkhorn iterates. An equivalent historical result could exist.
title: Sharp maximum-entry stability of fixed-marginal binary entropy coupling
